Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.account

Class AccountRateLimiter

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.account.AccountRateLimiter
@Component @EnableConfigurationProperties(AccountRateLimitProperties.class) public final class AccountRateLimiter extends Object
Rate limiter of the unauthenticated account endpoints (register, verify, reset request, reset), built on Bucket4j token buckets (FixedWindowBuckets). Requests are limited twice: per client address, and per e-mail address when the request names one, so neither a single client nor many clients aiming at one address can flood the server (and the mailboxes) with account mail or guess reset tokens. Each bucket holds the limit of its key and is refilled all at once every AccountRateLimitProperties.window().

The buckets of each kind of key live in a Caffeine cache bounded to AccountRateLimitProperties.maxTrackedKeys() entries, which also drops a bucket idle for a whole window (it would be full again anyway). They live in this instance only: several instances each apply the limits on their own, until the buckets move to a shared store through a Bucket4j ProxyManager (for example bucket4j-postgresql). The client address is request.getRemoteAddr(), so behind a proxy server.forward-headers-strategy must be set for it to be the real client.
